name: Season 3
description: After three years of manipulation by the enigmatic Bannon, the Scoobies discover they've been pawns in a sinister plan to build an army and unleash an apocalypse. As friends fall to darkness and holy ground is desecrated, the crew must navigate devastating bargains, terrible secrets, and the weight of prophecy. Their final confrontation will determine whether they can break free from Bannon's control—and whether the price of freedom is one they can bear to pay.
